title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR NON-BIODEGRADABLE MATERIAL (MANAGEMENT) HANDLING AND DISPOSAL ACT, 2007.

Long Title: An Act to prohibit and regulate handling and disposal of non-biodegradable material in the 1Union territory of Jammu and Kashmir and the matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
